summary: The client-contract probe executed and its result is consistent with the source prediction: with RestoreCommittedLogs on, the isolated node won with two of the committed five votes and its client Apply completed (minority_apply_ok true), while the flag-off control could not produce a leader there at all (minority_apply_ok false) — so a client can receive an acknowledgement for a write resting on a minority of the committed configuration. The run also shows the limit of the probe: no majority-side leader existed, so no conflicting entry and no FSM divergence was produced, and none is claimed. Both declared comparisons came back unknown only because the divergence harness never emitted the startup admission event its prerequisites required; the harness now emits that event with mode, snapshot count and expected server count, a local run confirms both admissions match and the same split (on: acknowledged write; off: no minority leader), and the corrected probe is submitted as a successor with previous_id and revision_reason for a completed comparison. The interpretation continues to cover the whole question as violated with defect_claim asserted for the two complete comparisons (configuration loss at witness index 15 with control 18; minority election at witness index 22 with control 25), keeps the schedule-dependence and bounded-window counterevidence, and holds the gap open on entry-level divergence resolved=false.
